skills.name: Appeal
skills.description: Appeal is a talent of charm and social abilities used to sway reactions, alter opinions, and convince others.

modifiers.example: Target is part of the same squad or commanding unit.
Target does not want to be bothered.

skills.name: Command
skills.description: Command is the ability to effectively lead others and issue orders.

modifiers.example: Command is suicidal or clearly against the group's best interests.

skills.name: Deception
skills.description: Deception is used to lie, disguise items, distract opponents, or twist orders.

subsections.name: Disguise Item
subsections.text: Trick someone into believing an item is something else.

subsections.name: Distract
subsections.text: Draw attention away from the real action.

subsections.name: Twist Orders
subsections.text: Alter the meaning of orders or lie about the situation.

skills.name: Gambling
skills.description: Gambling covers games of chance, betting, and improving odds.

subsections.name: Cheating
subsections.text: Opposed Gambling vs Investigation. Success grants +5 per Degree of Success to the Gambling Test.

skills.name: Interrogation
skills.description: Interrogation extracts information through mental or physical pressure.

subsections.name: Extended Attempts
subsections.text: Failed attempts double the time required and impose a -10 penalty on the next attempt.

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.description: Intimidation forces or scares opponents into compliance using physical presence, authority, or intellect.

skills.name: Negotiation
skills.description: Negotiation is used to strike deals, convince others, and resolve disputes.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Athletics covers climbing, swimming, balancing, jumping, falling safely, and acrobatic movement.

subsections.name: Strength
subsections.text: Climbing, swimming, and strength-based movement.

subsections.name: Agility
subsections.text: Balancing, jumping, catching landings, falling safely.

subsections.name: Move Silently
subsections.text: Opposed Athletics (Agility) vs Investigation (hearing).

modifiers.example: Target is part of the same squad.
Target does not want to be bothered.

skills.name: Evasion
skills.description: Evasion allows dodging attacks, avoiding radius damage, and parrying melee or ranged attacks.

subsections.name: Evade Into Cover
subsections.text: Move 2 meters per Degree of Success; limited by movement taken this round.

subsections.name: Evade Parry
subsections.text: Use Warfare Melee instead of Agility to parry melee attacks.

subsections.name: Range Weapon Parry
subsections.text: Opposed Strength/Agility/Warfare Melee; success imposes -20 To Hit on opponent.

skills.name: Stunting
skills.description: Stunting covers acrobatic maneuvers, flips, rolls, and cinematic movement.

skills.name: Pilot
skills.description: Pilot covers operation of vehicles, aircraft, and spacecraft.

skills.name: Camouflage
skills.description: Camouflage hides characters, equipment, vehicles, or weapons using environment and concealment techniques.

subsections.name: Hiding
subsections.text: Opposed by Investigation. Size above Normal imposes -5 per category.

subsections.name: Vehicle Camouflage
subsections.text: Vehicles suffer -5 per Size Point.

subsections.name: Weapon Concealing
subsections.text: [DW] +20, [OH] +10, [TH] -20, [HW] impossible without modification.

skills.name: Cryptography
skills.description: Cryptography encrypts and decrypts codes, hacks systems, and bypasses security.

skills.name: Demolition
skills.description: Demolition handles explosives, arming, disarming, structural analysis, and grenade cooking.

subsections.name: Arming Explosives
subsections.text: Extended 10 Full Actions; failure requires redo.

subsections.name: Disarming Explosives
subsections.text: Must exceed Degrees of Success used to arm; armer gains +30 to disarm.

subsections.name: Structural Weakness
subsections.text: Study structure for Pierce bonuses: +10% per DoS (1 Action), +25% per DoS (2 Actions).

subsections.name: Grenade Cooking
subsections.text: Trained +5, +10 gives +10, +20 gives +20.

skills.name: Medication
skills.description: Medication covers diagnosis, first aid, extended medical tests, alien biology, and removing special damage.

subsections.name: Human Biology
subsections.text: Standard medical procedures.

subsections.name: Covenant Biology
subsections.text: Requires study to understand alien physiology.

subsections.name: Xenobiology
subsections.text: Used for Mgalekgolo, Huragok, and similar species.

subsections.name: First Aid
subsections.text: Full Action; +1 Wound/Fatigue per Degree of Success; stabilizes Bleedout.

subsections.name: Extended Medical Test
subsections.text: 4 hours; +2 Wounds per DoS; increases Natural Healing by 1; triple effect in medical facilities.

subsections.name: Removing Special Damage
subsections.text: Extend test by 1 hour per effect removed.

subsections.name: Medical Assistance
subsections.text: Assistants reduce time by 1 hour per successful Medication Test.

subsections.name: Diagnosis
subsections.text: +20 bonus for known diseases; future diagnoses gain bonuses.

skills.name: Navigation
skills.description: Navigation covers pathfinding, map reading, and spatial awareness.

skills.name: Security
skills.description: Security handles locks, access systems, bypassing security devices, and intrusion detection.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: Survival covers wilderness knowledge, tracking, foraging, and environmental awareness.

skills.name: Technology
skills.description: Technology covers repair, diagnostics, electronic systems, and advanced machinery.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.description: Investigation covers gathering information, reading intentions, and environmental awareness.

subsections.name: Social Investigation
subsections.text: Gather information, ask questions, eavesdrop; opposed by Deception.

subsections.name: Insight
subsections.text: Read intentions; opposed by Deception.

subsections.name: Fieldcraft Investigation
subsections.text: Find hidden objects or characters; opposed by Camouflage.
